caveats: The official-close side is a third-party relay. Equality with the S&P DJI OFFICIAL close remains U; this measures agreement with a CONFIRMED_RELAY value.
CBOE publishes no independent PM exercise-settlement print: for SPXW/XSP it IS the official closing index value by rule. Declared in the spec before the run.
The IBKR SPX print is excluded by design — it was frozen (code Z) when read, so it is a competing explanation for the n=1 gap, not a reference.
Entitlement remains the separate, unaffected block on every IBKR family (L13).
evidence_tier_headline: R (official-close side is a third-party relay, not S&P DJI)

verdict.why: markets sharing a settlement date/event disagree on expiration_value; our reading of the field is falsified for those dates
